criterion_fired: Criterion 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 - multiple simultaneous failures suggest rubric miscalibration
suggested_change: Separate 'evidence quality' (is it direct or inferred?) from 'MEDDICC completeness' (do we have prospect engagement on this element?). A 5/10 on Metrics with qualitative pain is valid for early-stage discovery; don't retroactively penalize it. Score on what the call stage supports, not on what a mature close-stage call should contain. Remove ICP validation from MEDDICC rubric unless it's a deal-kill criterion defined upfront.
